newsitem.title: UK: Compass enters investment, co-operation deal.
newsitem.headline: Compass enters investment, co-operation deal.

text.p: Compass Group Plc said it has entered into a co-operation agreement with Selecta for its European vending and food service, whereby Compass will take on all purchasing for Selecta.
Selecta is part of Swiss group Valora, providing vending and food services to customers in both public and contract locations in eight countries, employing over 2,800 staff.
As part of the deal, Compass said it will take a 20 to 23.5 percent stake in Selecta, which will soon be floated on the Swiss stock exchange.
The total payment will be met by the issue of Compass group shares and cash in equal proportions, said the company, and completion is expected by the end of June 1997.
